Characteristics [Category]: bulk ATAC-seq chromatin accessibility profiling of a human chronic myelogenous leukemia cell line
Material Type: Bulk Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing (bulk ATAC-seq) on K562 cells, a suspension erythroleukemia line from pleural effusion of a 53-year-old female with chronic myelogenous leukemia in blast crisis, BCR-ABL-positive and broadly used for hematopoietic regulatory genomics.
Parameter [dna_extraction]: Bulk ATAC-seq nuclei preparation from suspension leukemia cells: a pooled cell population is lysed to isolate nuclei, then accessible DNA is tagged and fragmented by Tn5 transposase before sequencing-library amplification.
